# Zscaler ZIA Network, Firewall, and Tunnel Activity

Network session activity for Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) firewall and tunnel enforcement, normalized through ASIM `_Im_NetworkSession`. All queries filter on `EventVendor == 'Zscaler'` and use only standard ASIM fields.

parameters.name: Workspaces
parameters.label: Workspace
parameters.query:
Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
| project id, name

content.query:
let base = _Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler';
union isfuzzy=true
    (base | summarize Count=count() | extend Metric='Total Sessions'),
    (base | where DvcAction in~ ('Allow','Permit') | summarize Count=count() | extend Metric='Allowed Sessions'),
    (base | where DvcAction in~ ('Deny','Block','Drop') | summarize Count=count() | extend Metric='Denied Sessions'),
    (base | summarize Count=dcount(SrcIpAddr) | extend Metric='Unique Source IPs'),
    (base | summarize Count=dcount(DstIpAddr) | extend Metric='Unique Destination IPs'),
    (base | summarize Count=sum(NetworkBytes) | extend Metric='Total Bytes')
| project Metric, Count

_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| summarize SessionCount=count() by DvcAction, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where isnotempty(NetworkProtocol)
| summarize SessionCount=count() by NetworkProtocol
| top 10 by SessionCount desc

_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where isnotempty(NetworkDirection)
| summarize SessionCount=count() by NetworkDirection

_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where DvcAction in~ ('Deny', 'Block', 'Drop')
| summarize DeniedCount=count() by DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber
| top 10 by DeniedCount desc

_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where isnotempty(SrcIpAddr)
| summarize SessionCount=count() by SrcIpAddr
| top 10 by SessionCount desc

_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where isnotempty(DstIpAddr)
| summarize SessionCount=count() by DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber
| top 10 by SessionCount desc

_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| summarize TotalBytes=sum(NetworkBytes) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where isnotempty(SrcIpAddr)
| summarize TotalBytes=sum(NetworkBytes) by SrcIpAddr, DstIpAddr
| top 10 by TotalBytes desc
